# FDG8047

> DO NOT use `DateTimeKind` if `DateTimeOffset` can be used instead.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.4 DateTime and DateTimeOffset.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether DateTimeOffset can be used instead depends on the APIs and data the value comes from.

## From the book

`DateTimeKind` is an enum stored in `DateTime` to indicate whether the instance represents UTC, local time, or unspecified time zone.
